in_sanskrit.name: Chotelal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God in small form
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chotelal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Chote means small and Ishwar means God. So, Chotelal means the God in small or infant form.

in_hindi.name: चोटेलाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is small or young.

in_tamil.name: Chotelal
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God in small form
in_tamil.long_meaning: Chotelal ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Chote means small and Ishwar means God. So, Chotelal means the God in small or infant form.

in_telugu.name: Chotelal
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God in small form
in_telugu.long_meaning: Chotelal ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Chote means small and Ishwar means God. So, Chotelal means the God in small or infant form.

in_marathi.name: Chotelal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in small form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chotelal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chote means small and Ishwar means God. So, Chotelal means the God in small or infant form.

in_bengali.name: Chotelal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God in small form
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chotelal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Chote means small and Ishwar means God. So, Chotelal means the God in small or infant form.
